claims.text: A trusted lane over an HTTP endpoint on ANOTHER MACHINE turns the tier-2 allow-list off and reports ``withheld=[]`` while full repo source crosses the tailnet. That is precisely the justification ``offload.py:193-197`` rests on ("no bytes leave the machine"), borrowed by a host it was never written for.
claims.why: The claim references offload.py:193-197 which is not in this chunk; the behavior of trusted lane and withheld list is not verifiable from current code.

claims.text: Pass trusted_vendors=['{adapter.vendor}'] to opt in explicitly (it is recorded), or seat it on 127.0.0.1
claims.why: The claim that trusted_vendors is recorded is not verifiable from this chunk; the code only checks membership in trusted_vendors.

claims.text: Two seats with one identity: local qwen2.5-coder:7b and BENCH qwen2.5-coder:7b are the same weights on two sockets and would land as one indistinguishable pair of turns.
claims.why: The code checks for duplicate actor ids and raises ValueError if collided is non-empty.

claims.text: A hit refuses the whole council -- there is no redact-and-send -- and NO VENDOR IS CALLED.
claims.why: The code sets ended='floor_refusal' and creates turns without calling any vendor; no vendor calls are made in that branch.

claims.text: Charge the token ceiling BEFORE dispatch, from the assembled prompt. Reconciling after the call is not a budget.
claims.why: The code computes per_call_tokens before the loop and increments tokens_charged before dispatching jobs.

claims.text: Per path, per file, never over the assembled prompt: the path tier is the only thing that catches a patch which ADDS `.env`, and a concatenated scan kills it.
claims.why: The claim refers to behavior of floor_check which is not defined in this chunk; the code only calls floor_check.

observations.what: live_egress_seats function called but not defined in this chunk.
Duplicate identity check uses actors list and count; if count > 1, raises ValueError.
Trusted lane enforcement raises ValueError if lane='trusted' on off-machine HTTP endpoint without explicit trusted_vendors.
Pre-flight floor check (floor_check) is called; if refusal, creates refusal turns and ends council without vendor calls.
Round loop checks wall clock deadline and token ceiling; if budget exhausted, appends budget round and breaks.
